comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Obtained from the rare green-sky map of the Sea of Wonders (Alexandria version), specifically from objects surrounded by golden glittering light.

It can be mounted on the rear/left right of a ship, and is used as a base item to create the Ancient Persian Decor decoration for the Memory of the Ancient City Memorial Album. Not to be confused with the Acanthus ship decoration.

Source: gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?ShipItem/Decoration , yukimiiro.blog.fc2.com/blog-entry-638.html
